testProvenance.note: frozen, handed off; not edited by this writer

capabilityDelta.before: customer_records write path is legacy-only; P12 adapter exists but is not reachable via any cutover control
capabilityDelta.after: consumers/customer-app-core/customer-data-cutover.mjs adds createCustomerDataCutover: a frozen controller defaulting to legacy, gated cutover() that verifies compatibility via a real pg client before switching activeWriter to 'application', application-path insert wrapped in one BEGIN/mfk_begin_tenant_context/P12-adapter-insert/COMMIT transaction with rollback-on-failure, and rollback()/close() for reverting and pool teardown
capabilityDelta.notRunnable: No live CreateCustomer traffic has moved; nothing wires customer-data-cutover.mjs into app-core yet, and the default pg.Pool path is untested against a real database in this package. This is executable cutover capability, not a completed migration.

owner.once: Musteri kaydi her zaman eski (legacy) yoldan yaziliyordu, degistirme imkani yoktu.
owner.simdi: Artik bir 'cutover' anahtari var: kapaliyken hala eski yoldan yaziyor, acilinca (once uyumluluk kontrolu gecerse) yeni P12 yoluna, tek islemli (transaction) guvenli kayda geciyor; sorun olursa geri alinip (rollback) tekrar eskiye donulebiliyor.
owner.fark: Once tek secenek vardi (eski yol). Simdi kontrollu, geri alinabilir bir gecis mekanizmasi var ama hala hicbir yerde acik olarak kullanilmiyor.
owner.kullaniciYolculugu: Bir CRM formu 'musteri kaydet' dedi -> once dogrudan eski tabloya yaziliyordu -> simdi ayni akis, ama gelecekte bu anahtar acilirsa kayit, AYNI mevcut customer_records tablosuna, kiracı (tenant) baglami kurulmus tek bir islemde yazilabilecek; su an anahtar hicbir yerde acilmadigi icin kullanicinin gordugu davranis degismedi.
owner.kalanEngel: P14: audit/outbox/idempotency parity, bu kontrolcunun app-core icinde gercekten baglanmasi (live composition), ve gecis-donemi Kernel tarafi temizlik.

capabilityDelta.rollback: git rm/revert on all four package files (three writer files plus the frozen test); no DB migration, no adapter, no config touched.
